generation.explanation: A Riemann sum approximates the area under a curve by adding up thin rectangles. Here we use right-endpoint rectangles under y = x² on [0, 2]. The exact area is 8/3 ≈ 2.6667. Drag the slider to increase the number of rectangles and watch the sum converge to that value.
